basic_info.description: This well-maintained 6-unit building is located in the highly desirable Lone Mountain neighborhood, presenting an excellent investment opportunity. The property features a versatile unit mix of four two-bedroom units and two one-bedroom units, offering flexibility for prospective tenants. Two of the units will be delivered vacant, providing immediate leasing opportunities at market rates, while the remaining units are tenant-occupied, generating steady rental income. One of the building's standout features is its large garage, which offers six parking spaces. Currently, only one space is rented, leaving significant potential for additional rental income. Situated near the University of San Francisco (USF), this property is in an ideal location for attracting renters. Just a 2-3 minute walk from the building, tenants can take advantage of Rossi Park, which features a recently remodeled swimming facility, making it a great spot for recreation and relaxation. Additionally, residents can enjoy a variety of nearby dining and nightlife options, including popular spots like Altamirano, Eats, Price Hot, Magic Flute, Spruce, Social, and more, further enhancing the appeal of this prime location.
